steps.text: If the player has a fishbowl helmet equipped:

steps.npc: Oh! Take that horrid thing off your head immediately!

steps.text: If the player had a fishbowl helmet equipped, but took it off:
If the player has a fishbowl helmet or the Medallion of the Deep in their inventory:

steps.npc: You're not going into deeper water with that bowl.

steps.player: Why don't you like my helmet?

steps.npc: My sister was once trapped in one of those for a long time by your kind. It was awful and she's still terrified of them. We don't allow them beyond this point anymore.

steps.player: What shall I do with it?

steps.npc: Put it on the pile over there.
Oops. Nevermind. I'm sure you'll manage. Just look for bubbles.
I'm Mairin, one of the many merfolk here.

steps.player: Many? I don't see that many...

steps.npc: Just because you don't see us, doesn't mean we're not there.

steps.player: That's kind of creepy. What do you actually do?

steps.npc: Mostly stop people entering beyond this wreck with those horrid fishbowls.

options.text: How do I breathe underwater without a helmet

steps.player: How do I breathe underwater without a helmet.

steps.npc: Just find some bubbles, or other sources of air.
Yes, some fish can be a good source of air too..

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help you?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help you?

steps.npc: Yes! You can collect the tears of my poor trapped sister.

steps.player: What? Tears? But, they're water, surely underwater they would...

steps.npc: She's a mermaid, like me. Didn't you know our tears are the pearls of the sea? You humans.

steps.player: Ok, keep your scales on. Where would I find these tears?

steps.npc: They usually end up secreted in clams or other places.

steps.player: What do I get out of it?

steps.npc: Well, I have access to a lot of old stuff that's fallen down under the water, so I'm sure I could reward you in some way.
If you find any special glistening tears, I can teach you some useful Agility and Thieving techniques too. So will you help me?

options.text: What have you got to trade?

steps.player: What have you got to trade?
